```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)
library(CIBERSORT)

```

## R Markdown

Reference data obtained from: Discovery and Verification of Extracellular miRNA Biomarkers for Non-invasive Prediction of Pre-eclampsia in Asymptomatic Women. Cell Rep Med. 2020 May 19; 1(2).Two tables (Supplemental T5 Sheet 2 and 5) were available to deconvolute the data


## load data 
```{r load_data}

#ref Supplemental table 5 sheet 2
#st5s2<-read.csv("C:/Users/mk2583/OneDrive - cumc.columbia.edu/Deyssenroth_Lab/Tutorials/miRNATissueAtlas_CIBERSORT/UCSD-PregEV-Ref-TableS5-sheet2.csv", header = T, row.names=1)

#ref Supplemental table 5 sheet 4
#st5s4<-read.csv("C:/Users/mk2583/OneDrive - cumc.columbia.edu/Deyssenroth_Lab/Tutorials/miRNATissueAtlas_CIBERSORT/UCSD-PregEV-Ref-TableS5-sheet4.csv", header = T, row.names=1)

reference<-readRDS("C:/Users/mk2583/OneDrive - cumc.columbia.edu/Deyssenroth_Lab/Tutorials/miRNATissueAtlas_CIBERSORT/miRNA_reference.rds")

data<-readRDS("../../normalized_data/vst.RDS")

Covariates<-readRDS("../../../../../Data/Covariates/Covariates_pilot.rds")

```

## format EV data
```{r}
##subset to miRNAs
miRNA_data <- data[grepl("^hsa-let|^hsa-miR", rownames(data)), ] #150 features


## subset to miRNAs in reference
miRNA_data<-miRNA_data[rownames(miRNA_data)%in%reference$miRNA,] #105
  
miRNA_data[is.na(miRNA_data)]<-0   # replace Nas in data for 0

```

## format reference data
```{r format_ref}
#table(row.names(miRNA_data)%in%row.names(st5s2))
# 137 miRNA true; 12 missing
#table(row.names(miRNA_data)%in%row.names(st5s4))
# 86 miRNA true  64 missing

reference<-reference%>%
  filter(miRNA%in%rownames(miRNA_data))%>%
  column_to_rownames(., 'miRNA')


```

## deconvolution
```{r}
mirDecon <- cibersort(as.matrix(reference), as.matrix(miRNA_data))
colnames(mirDecon)

mirDecon<-mirDecon[, 1:13]# only tissues

mirDecon<-mirDecon%>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "bam")%>%
  left_join(Covariates %>% dplyr::select(bam,SID,Group,BMI,delivery_mode))
  
mirDecon_long<-mirDecon%>%
  pivot_longer(!c(SID,bam,Group,BMI,delivery_mode),names_to="Tissue",values_to="Value")


mirDecon_tissue_plot<-ggplot(mirDecon_long, aes(x = Tissue, y = Value,fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_boxplot()+xlab('')+ylab("tissue proportion")+ylim(0,0.8)+
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option='C')+
  #ggtitle("UCSD PMID:32864636 Deconv#1 RefTabS5-sheet2/Data:TabS5-sheet5")+
  theme_minimal()+ theme(axis.text.x =element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),legend.position = "none")

pdf("../../CYBERSORT/Plots/mirDecon_Tissue.pdf",height=3,width=4)
mirDecon_tissue_plot
dev.off()

```

## deconvolution 1 by PE, BMI, delivery mode
```{r}
mirDecon_PE_ttest<-mirDecon_long %>%
  drop_na(Value)%>%
  nest(data = -c(Tissue)) %>% 
  mutate(
    fit = map(data, ~ t.test(Value ~ Group, data = .x)),
    tidied = map(fit, broom::tidy)) %>% 
  unnest(tidied)
#liver, platelets

mirDecon_PE_plot<-ggplot(mirDecon_long, aes(x = Tissue, y = Value,fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot()+xlab('')+ylab("tissue proportion")+ylim(0,0.8)+
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option='C')+
  #ggtitle("UCSD PMID:32864636 Deconv#1 RefTabS5-sheet2/Data:TabS5-sheet5")+
  theme_minimal()+ theme(axis.text.x =element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),legend.position = "none")


pdf("../../CYBERSORT/Plots/mirDecon_PE.pdf",height=3,width=4)
mirDecon_PE_plot
dev.off()

mirDecon_BMI_ttest<-mirDecon_long %>%
  drop_na(Value)%>%
  nest(data = -c(Tissue)) %>% 
  mutate(
    fit = map(data, ~ t.test(Value ~ BMI, data = .x)),
    tidied = map(fit, broom::tidy)) %>% 
  unnest(tidied)
#none

mirDecon_BMI_plot<-ggplot(mirDecon_long, aes(x = Tissue, y = Value,fill = BMI)) +
  geom_boxplot()+xlab('')+ylab("tissue proportion")+ylim(0,0.8)+
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option='C')+
  #ggtitle("UCSD PMID:32864636 Deconv#1 RefTabS5-sheet2/Data:TabS5-sheet5")+
  theme_minimal()+ theme(axis.text.x =element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),legend.position = "none")

pdf("../../CYBERSORT/Plots/mirDecon_BMI.pdf",height=3,width=4)
mirDecon_BMI_plot
dev.off()

mirDecon_DM_ttest<-mirDecon_long %>%
  drop_na(Value)%>%
  nest(data = -c(Tissue)) %>% 
  mutate(
    fit = map(data, ~ t.test(Value ~ delivery_mode, data = .x)),
    tidied = map(fit, broom::tidy)) %>% 
  unnest(tidied)
#placenta, PBMC

mirDecon_DM_plot<-ggplot(mirDecon_long, aes(x = Tissue, y = Value,fill = delivery_mode)) +
  geom_boxplot()+xlab('')+ylab("tissue proportion")+ylim(0,0.8)+
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option='C')+
  #ggtitle("UCSD PMID:32864636 Deconv#1 RefTabS5-sheet2/Data:TabS5-sheet5")+
  theme_minimal()+ theme(axis.text.x =element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),legend.position = "none")

pdf("../../CYBERSORT/Plots/mirDecon_DM.pdf",height=3,width=4)
mirDecon_DM_plot
dev.off()
```
